summary: Keel Infrastructure Corp. filed an 8-K reporting the pricing of an upsized $400 million aggregate principal amount of 1.250% convertible senior notes due 2032 (from an initially announced $350 million), with an initial purchasers' option for an additional $58 million over 13 days. Net proceeds will fund capped call transactions and general corporate purposes, including data center project deposits or collateral. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, spin-off, or other special situation is described; it is a routine capital markets financing.
